'''Ion beamers''' were medical devices that generated electromagnetic impulses able to disrupt the nervous system.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|111|ion beamer}}</ref>

Ion beamers were used by medical units of the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]]. Some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a bunch of smugglers stole a crate of ion beamers from the CDF [[Mobile Medical Unit 4-077]] during a training exercise.<ref name="SWG:MHHSP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Mobile Hospital Has Smuggler Problem}} on Corellia</ref>

Notable users of ion beamers were the [[Ssi-ruu]]k who improved the technology to use it as a weapon.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer|ion paddle beamer]] was the primary hand weapon of the Ssi-ruuk. Although it could be lethal at short range, the Ssi-ruuk mainly used this weapon to neutralized ans stun their enemies for further [[entechment]].<ref name="TEGtWaT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
